items.title: What Is GE HealthCare Technologies (GEHC) Signaling With Its RSNA 2026 AI Push?
items.summary: GE HealthCare Technologies (NasdaqGS:GEHC) used RSNA 2026 to unveil a slate of AI, imaging, and workflow products. The business introduced ViewPoint Ultra, an enterprise-wide ultrasound reporting and analytics platform aimed at standardizing imaging workflows across hospitals. Management also showed Imaging 360 AI assistant and protocoling tools, designed to support radiology operations and exam consistency across modalities.
